limits: Four report files are observed training mechanics oracles, not four independently reviewed source examples. All remain two exposed fictional authored sparse384 rows, with training/evaluation masks zero.

Comparing preupdate step0/row0 with step1/row1 confounds both state and row changes; it is not within-row learning progress. The available later row1 arm comparison has different trained weights and objective history, not same-checkpoint objective causality.
